## Resolution Code (RC)

How a finding was closed: `remediated`, `risk-accepted`, `false-positive`, `duplicate`, `superseded` or `out-of-scope`. "Closed" alone hides whether anything was fixed; the code says so, and two codes carry obligations the closing command enforces — `requiresAction` (remediated: the corrective task must be done) and `requiresApproval` (risk-accepted: someone senior said so).

```ts
import { ResolutionCodeField } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/records/resolution-code-field';
@field resolution = contains(ResolutionCodeField);
```

Embedded shows the code as a pill with the obligation it carries; atom is the pill alone.

## Example
The contained example is `risk-accepted` — the code that needs an approval.

## Non-goals
Does not perform the closure or check the obligations — the Finding's close command reads `requiresAction` / `requiresApproval` and refuses when they are unmet. Not a status (a finding is open, in remediation or closed; the code qualifies *closed*). Not a root cause taxonomy.
